name: GEM Services, Inc.
summary: GEM Services, Inc. provides services for power management semiconductors. It provides assembly services, including wafer probe, assembly, and test; packaging development; and electrical testing services, such as wafer probe, electrical test, data-log, and characterization testing. The company offers reliability testing services comprising reliability testing capability and failure analysis services; and logistic services consisting of drop shipment services and shipping directly to the end customers.
